labels.alt_presets_behavior_desc: The app will try to maintain bandwidth corresponding to selected preset instead of matching between resolution, fps and codec.
labels.amazon_frame_drop_fix_desc: Intended for Amazon Stick devices. May work on other devices too.
labels.ambilight_ratio_fix_desc: Fixes absent bias lighting. Fixes incorrect aspect ratio or video scale. Fixes blank screenshots. Affects performance!
labels.amlogic_fix_desc: Frame drop fix on Amlogic-based devices.
labels.audio_sync_fix_desc: An alternative way to synchronize audio/video. It\'s considered obsolete, but in some cases, may help.
labels.disable_network_error_fixing_desc: You probably need to enable this option if you\'re using a VPN
labels.disable_stream_buffer_desc: Fix for situations when the stream too far behind. Note: the stream may start to lag.
labels.disable_vsync_desc: This option disables aligning frames with the display\'s vertical sync signal. This could improve performance on low-end devices by releasing CPU resources.
labels.force_legacy_codecs_desc: Significantly improves performance on low-end devices. Maximum resolution is 360p.
labels.force_sw_codec_desc: Could play almost any video, but performance is very poor.
labels.live_stream_fix_4k_desc: Warn, this tweak disables the rewinding of streams. Significantly improves live stream performance. Maximum resolution is 4K.
labels.live_stream_fix_desc: Warn, this tweak disables the rewinding of streams. Significantly improves live stream performance on low-end devices. Maximum resolution is 1080p.
labels.playback_notifications_fix_desc: Hides track change notifications. Could be useful on AOSP-based firmware.
labels.prefer_avc_over_vp9: Codec selection: prefer avc over vp9
labels.prefer_ipv4_desc: Could fix situations when the app isn\'t working at all.\nNote. May cause hangs and crashes (especially on Android 8 devices or Dune HD)
labels.skip_codec_profile_check_desc: Don\'t check codec support when starting a video. Could be helpful on buggy firmware.
labels.sony_frame_drop_fix_desc: Fix lags on Sony TV and some other devices. Note: possible problems with audio synchronization.
labels.tunneled_video_playback_desc: NOTE: pause may not work properly! Tunneled video playback promises benefits such as better audio/video synchronization (AV sync) and smoother playback. Required Android 5+
labels.unlock_all_formats_desc: On some devices the firmware incorrectly reports some formats as unsupported, even if they are.\n(e.g. 1080p smart TVs tend to report 4k as not supported).
